dedupe_keys.name: buenos aires urban fabric building height by parcel tejido urbano

description: Subsecretaría de Planeamiento, Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires publishes the built fabric of the City of Buenos Aires classified by building height (the portal describes it as "edificación de la Ciudad especificada según altura"). Coverage: the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina; data up to 2021 according to the portal, marked as a historical dataset and last modified on 2026-07-01. Format and access: ZIP, CSV, JSON, XLSX, downloadable without registration from the Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-2.5-AR; cost: free. Caveats: the data stop in 2021 and are labelled historical, so newer construction is missing; the height classes, geometry type and feature count were not read. Simulation uses: building-stock exposure by height class, urban morphology inputs for wind, heat and flood models, and density scenarios in land-use planning. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
name: Buenos Aires: urban fabric, building height by parcel (Tejido Urbano)
